response.justification: While the candidate is an experienced senior developer with a broad background, he lacks nearly all of the core requirements for this role: there is no native-level Japanese proficiency (a hard requirement), no meaningful embedded networking or Linux kernel modification experience, no security-protocol background (MACsec, 802.1X, etc.), and only brief C/C++ exposure from a short stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015. His career trajectory has moved firmly toward web and full-stack development, making this a poor fit for a mid-senior embedded security firmware position.
strengths: 13+ years of professional software development experience across diverse stacks
Some systems-level experience (C/C++ at National Instruments, low-latency DLang services, Linux)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, testing culture, and open-source contributions
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency, which is an explicit native-level requirement
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, Linux kernel, or security-protocol experience (MACsec, 802.1X, SNMP, NETCONF)
C programming experience is minimal and dated (~6 months in 2014-2015); current focus is web/TypeScript

key_factors.factor: Broad senior engineering experience and Linux familiarity
